name: usage-bar
description: A one-line bar above the prompt: context window used/total, 5-hour and weekly limit usage with reset countdowns. Every section is optional.

show_context.title: Show context window
show_context.description: Tokens in the context window, used/total.

show_five_hour.title: Show 5-hour limit
show_five_hour.description: Usage of the 5-hour window and when it resets (Pro/Max plans).

show_weekly.title: Show weekly limit
show_weekly.description: Usage of the 7-day window and when it resets (Pro/Max plans).

show_reset.title: Show reset countdowns
show_reset.description: How long until each limit window resets.

show_meters.title: Show meters
show_meters.description: A small bar beside each percentage. Dropped automatically when the terminal is narrow.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: above-prompt: its own line directly above the input. footer: appended, dim, to the hint line under the input.

warn_pct.title: Warning at (%)
warn_pct.description: A section turns yellow from this percentage.

critical_pct.title: Critical at (%)
critical_pct.description: A section turns red from this percentage.
